title: Observability: token/KV metrics + disk logging + dashboards & alert tuning
author: Maya Patel
release_notes:
- Add token-level KV cache and request cost/latency metrics
- Expose disk logging metrics (flush latency, write queue depth)
- New Grafana dashboards for token/KV, disk logging, and end-to-end latency
- Tune alert thresholds to reduce false positives and add runbook links
description: Motivation: customers and SREs have been asking for better visibility into token-level cost/latency, KV cache behavior, and disk logging performance after several P2/P3 incidents where degraded disk performance amplified tail latency. This PR adds token-level and KV-specific metrics, exposes disk logging internals (flush latency, backlog, write errors), ships new Grafana dashboards, and updates alert thresholds and runbooks. Checklist: - [x] Add token-level counters and histograms (per-model, per-route) - [x] Instrument KV cache (hits, misses, evictions, write-latency) - [x] Expose disk logging metrics (flush_latency_ms, write_queue_depth, write_errors_total) - [x] New dashboard panels (overview, token-cost breakdown, KV insights, disk logging) - [x] Alert tuning: lower sensitivity for transient spikes, add alert suppression window for planned maintenance - [x] Add unit + integration tests for metrics emission - [x] Update docs and runbooks (console + ops) Summary of changes and rationale: - Metrics: added prometheus metrics with stable label sets (model, route, deployment, instance_type) and token-level breakdowns: redwood_tokens_generated_total (counter), redwood_token_latency_ms_bucket (histogram) and per-token-cost estimates exported for cost debugging. KV metrics added: redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_evictions_total, redwood_kv_write_latency_ms_bucket. Disk logging metrics: redwood_disklog_flush_latency_ms_bucket, redwood_disklog_write_queue_depth_gauge, redwood_disklog_write_errors_total and associated tags for device and instance. - Exporter changes: updated the metrics exporter to support high-cardinality label rollups and configurable cardinality policies (default safe set includes model, route, region). Added a lightweight summarizer that emits per-minute rollups for token cost so dashboards can render large workloads efficiently. - Dashboards: new Grafana folders and 6 dashboards added (Overview, Token cost/latency, KV cache, Disk logging, Traces by token path, Alert dashboard). Panels include pre-computed rollups and links to trace samples. - Alerts: tuned token-latency alert to ignore single-minute spikes for high-QPS routes, added a suppression window for rolling deployment events, and introduced a new KV eviction rate alert with a 5-minute evaluation window. Each alert links to runbook ENG-1189 with remediation steps. - Tests: unit tests for metrics emitters, integration test suite exercise high-throughput token generation with KV interactions and validate metric cardinality controls. - Docs: console docs + runbook updates in docs/ops/observability. Commits summary: - 7 commits: 1) initial metrics scaffolding and basic token metrics 2) KV cache instrumentation + tests 3) disk logging metrics + exporter changes 4) dashboard JSONs + panels 5) alert rule changes + runbook links 6) integration tests and load test harness adjustments 7) docs and small fixes CI: initial run had a flaky integration test (timeout on load harness); fixed by increasing timeout and making test idempotent. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, lint, integration, e2e). Files changed (high level): - pkg/metrics/token_metrics.go: adds token counters/histograms - pkg/metrics/kv_metrics.go: KV cache instrumentation - pkg/logging/disk_logger.go: emit disk logging metrics and error handling - infra/monitoring/grafana/dashboards/token_kv_overview.json: new dashboard - infra/monitoring/grafana/dashboards/disk_logging.json: new dashboard - infra/monitoring/alerts/alerts.yaml: tuned alert rules + runbook links - tests/integration/metrics_load_test.go: load test for metrics emission - docs/ops/observability/token_kv_dashboard.md: dashboard and runbook docs - tools/metrics/exporter/rollup.go: rollup and cardinality controls Review summary: - Ethan Brooks: requested clearer cardinality defaults and suggested adding a "rollup_interval" config to avoid high-cardinality explosion; asked to document label sets in README - Author response: added configurable rollup_interval (default 60s) and documented label whitelist/blacklist - Sofia Martinez: flagged alert thresholds for KV eviction were too aggressive for Dedicated customers; suggested 5-minute window + tiered severity - Author response: implemented tiered severity + 5-minute eval window (INFO -> P0 mapping in runbook) - Rakesh Iyer: asked for trace linking to be added on dashboard panels; requested one sample trace per alert in panel context - Author response: added trace sample links and limited to 1 sample to keep dashboard loading fast Post-merge notes: deployment will be rolled out in three waves (canary -> staged -> global) to monitor alert noise; monitoring runbook ENG-1189 updated with dashboards and remediation steps for disk contention.
commits: 7 commits: initial metrics scaffolding; KV instrumentation; disk logging metrics; dashboard JSONs; alert rule changes; integration test fixes; docs
